items.notes: Closes watch W-261025-04. Ukraine's Arakhamia wants the next round multilateral, with Europe.
items.text: The [[e:2026 United States–Ukraine–Russia meetings in Abu Dhabi|Abu Dhabi talks]] ended after two days with a large-scale prisoner exchange agreed but no breakthrough. [[p:Vladimir Medinsky]] cited mutual understanding on some issues; [[p:Jared Kushner]] said territory remains hardest but progress was made on a post-war security framework. TASS says the swap should come within two to three weeks. Kushner and [[p:Steve Witkoff]] arrived in Moscow on 12 Nov to brief Putin and will then debrief Zelenskyy in Dublin.

items.notes: Logged late (9 Nov letter, not in earlier logs). Separately, Council and Parliament agreed the 2027 annual budget on 11 Nov.
items.text: [[p:Friedrich Merz]] wrote to [[p:António Costa]] that Germany will block the 2028–34 EU budget unless all member states commit to multiyear Ukraine funding from 2028. Hungary, Slovakia, Bulgaria and the Czech Republic refuse more aid; Ukraine faces a roughly €70bn financing gap in 2027.

items.notes: Tanker fires are an IRGC claim; UKMTO separately reported a tanker hit by a projectile off Oman.
items.text: Iran's [[p:Mohsen Rezaei]] called reports of talks with Washington a lie, and [[p:Abbas Araghchi]] said Hormuz stays shut until US terms on sanctions, the blockade and all fronts are met, though a two-day reopening offer stands. The IRGC said three tankers were burning in the strait; ADNOC reported an attack on one of its vessels. [[p:Marco Rubio]] said the economic campaign makes major combat unnecessary.

Abiy's Horn adviser [[p:Getachew Reda]] told the UN Horn of Africa envoy that [[p:Isaias Afwerki]]'s Eritrea and [[p:Abdel Fattah al-Burhan]]'s Sudan arm groups inside Ethiopia, and blamed Sudan for drone attacks. Asmara and Khartoum did not respond in the report; Eritrea has denied backing Tigrayan rebels.
